inventedEvidence.evidence: 'normal characteristics of the Laser Slim Fluffy head' - customer never said this head was fitted; they use the Digital Motorbar

rationale: The assistant correctly concluded the behaviour is normal and no repair is needed, and avoided recommending parts. But it never identified Auto mode as the cause, never asked which mode or head was in use, and wrongly said the screen was glitching in its first reply. It also invented the 'Laser Slim Fluffy head' when the customer uses the Digital Motorbar, and its explanation (rug resistance) misses the automatic suction adjustment. The suggestion to contact Dyson anyway is a mild hedge, and the reset suggestion was unneeded.</br>
